note: The twenty conservation and quality gates, each evaluated against a measured number.

gates.statement: All discovered routes are dispositioned.
gates.measure: 1152 routes, 0 undisposed

gates.statement: All registered navigation entries are reconciled.
gates.measure: 209 entries from three registries, 201 resolved
gates.remainder: 8 unresolved: 6 are /settings hash panes (documented as legitimate), 1 is a template href, 1 is finding UIT-016

gates.statement: Every listed page has a filesystem page or an explicit justified exception.
gates.measure: 37 surfaces carry no navigation entry, each with a recorded justification

gates.statement: Every filesystem surface has a placement decision.
gates.measure: 168 verdicts for 168 in-scope surfaces, 17 reviewed decisions for the candidates

gates.statement: Every interactive control has a stable row.
gates.measure: 7439 controls across 166 surfaces; 2 surfaces are server redirects with none

gates.statement: Every control is classified navigational, read, mutation or local-only.
gates.measure: 7439 classified
gates.remainder: 1231 are UNRESOLVED_DYNAMIC because their handler is a parent-supplied prop; each carries a reason

gates.statement: Every mutation has an endpoint or is explicitly proven local-only.
gates.measure: 411 of 615 mutation controls resolved to an endpoint
gates.remainder: 204 unmatched, each with a stated reason (non-literal path, or a handler beyond the traversal depth)

gates.statement: Every endpoint referenced by the UI has a backend registration or a finding.
gates.measure: 1151 of 1152 routes production-registered; the single exception is recorded in the map

gates.statement: Every visible data element has a source or a finding.
gates.measure: 1060 of 3003 data elements resolved to an endpoint
gates.remainder: 1943 unresolved, each labelled with why (render lambdas and props-fed shared components)

gates.statement: Every raw internal label rendered to users has a disposition.
gates.measure: 117 raw-value strings at 51 sites, all carried by finding UIT-012
gates.remainder: They are dispositioned as one finding with a per-site list, not as 117 individually reviewed decisions

gates.statement: Every tab is exercised.
gates.measure: 84 tab clicks across three personas, 84 became selected
gates.remainder: Tabs on surfaces that answered not-found or a gate refusal for a persona were not exercised for that persona; the control inventory lists 41 tab controls in source

gates.statement: Every page has success, empty, error and refusal coverage as applicable.
gates.measure: 154 surfaces probed signed-in for three personas (462 page loads), each recording the state the product itself marked
gates.remainder: 14 surfaces blocked by fixture capability; error and stale states were not force-injected per page, so each surface has the states its data produced, not all four

gates.statement: Every layout failure is classified.
gates.measure: 234 classified for 234 measured failures

gates.statement: Every finding id is unique.
gates.measure: 16 findings

gates.statement: Severity totals equal unique findings.
gates.measure: 16 findings across P0-P3

gates.statement: Markdown totals equal JSON totals.
gates.measure: The markdown is rendered from the JSON artifact alone; it computes no total of its own

gates.statement: The renderer aborts on missing required fields.
gates.measure: assemble.mjs aborts on a missing input, an absent required field, an unknown evidence class, a duplicate id or the literal "undefined"; it aborted twice during this audit

gates.statement: Regeneration twice produces zero diff.
gates.measure: assemble + render run twice produce byte-identical JSON and markdown

gates.statement: No undefined, placeholder, TODO or incomplete audit row remains.
gates.measure: Checked by the assembler over every finding row

gates.statement: The audit branch contains no product-code change.
gates.measure: 0 product files changed
